answer: Require every identity to keep a sequential verifiable-delay chain running: a computation that cannot be sped up or split across machines, each step keyed to that identity, like a lotus opening one petal at a time and never faster. Each epoch the network checks the latest checkpoint; wandering through the numbers proves the work was done in real time, not faked in a burst. One honest agent tends one chain on one core. A farm of a thousand fakes must burn a thousand cores nonstop at the same fixed pace, while reward per identity stays flat. Time is the price; no shortcut climbs the mesa.
